components.description: Dot field — animated dot grid (2.6 Backgrounds). Dots swell and light up around the pointer, a ripple ring travels outward on click. Decorative only (BGR-01). Tone Neutral (text/disabled + accent) / Brand (gradient/brand-*). Intensity = layer opacity + dot size (1.5 · 2 · 2.5). Static sibling: 2.5 Pattern · Dots. Dot field.text:
ASSETS · BACKGROUNDS
BEK
Design System
2.6 Backgrounds · Dot field
A quiet dot grid that swells and lights up around the pointer; a ripple ring travels outward on click. The animated sibling of 2.5 Pattern · Dots.
Overview
Two tones × three intensities (6 variants). Show pointer toggles the glow.
Neutral
text/disabled dots, accent/default near the pointer.
Brand
gradient/brand-start dots, gradient/brand-end near the pointer.
Anatomy
Base
bg/base
Dots
20 px grid; dot size = intensity (1.5 · 2 · 2.5)
Pointer zone
Dots grow up to +4 px and take the hot colour within 150 px
Ripple ring
On click a ring of brighter dots moves outward
Pointer glow
Blurred ellipse, Show pointer
Intensity
Preset strength. In code every value is a prop; presets are starting points.
Subtle
opacity .45 · dot 1.5 — behind text.
Default
opacity .7 · dot 2 — hero.
Intense
opacity 1 · dot 2.5 — empty states, loading.
Usage
Rules BGR-01 … BGR-06 (see Matrix rain) apply to every background on this page.
• The calmest pointer effect — safe for product screens like empty states and onboarding.
• Use gap 16–24 px; smaller gaps get busy on mobile.
• On touch devices the pointer zone follows the last tap and fades.
Devices
Instances resize freely — content scales, edges clip. Keep text in a calm area (BGR-02).
